name: One&Only Reethi Rah
insider_take: This ultra-luxe resort spans an entire 109-acre island in North Malé Atoll, making it one of the largest resort islands in the Maldives with an incredible 12 pristine beaches to explore.
whats_special: One&Only Reethi Rah features the largest overwater villas in the Maldives, some stretching over 3,000 square feet. The resort is also home to the region's first tennis court and sits on a natural coral island with exceptional house reef snorkeling just steps from shore.
pro_tip: Book the Grand Water Villa for direct access to the best snorkeling spots, or time your visit during whale shark season (August-November) when these gentle giants frequent the nearby waters.
dont_miss: The resort's signature "sandbank picnics" on a private uninhabited island, sunset dolphin cruises in the resort's traditional dhoni boats, and treatments at the award-winning One&Only Spa featuring four overwater treatment pavilions suspended above the lagoon.
pros: Largest private resort island in the Maldives with pristine beaches
Exceptional overwater and beach villa accommodations
Multiple award-winning dining venues and cuisine options
